topic: Platform strategy: one AI vs many
angle: Tool sprawl kills ROI; standardize on one primary AI to reduce overhead and improve quality.
sourceTitle: Why one AI is better than four #598
linkedinPost:
Most AI “platform strategies” are just tool sprawl with a nicer slide.

Azeem Azhar argues one AI often beats four. In the enterprise, I see this daily: context fragmentation, duplicated prompts, conflicting guardrails, and a support queue that never ends. The hidden tax crushes ROI.

My take: standardize on a primary AI surface area for 70–80% of use. That doesn’t mean monoculture; it means a backbone.

What changes when you pick one:
- Reusable prompt libraries, evals, and policies that compound.
- Fewer integrations to secure and monitor; clearer data residency story.
- Better enablement: one playbook, fresher examples, faster onboarding.
- Cleaner metrics: time saved and quality gains tracked apples-to-apples.

Keep an “exceptions lane” for edge cases, but make it earn its keep with measured lift.

If value is stalling, your problem might not be the model—it’s the portfolio. Consolidate, measure, then expand where the data says so.

Where could consolidation free 20% of your team’s time next quarter? #AIStrategy #AITransformation #EnterpriseAI
